preprocessing: patient-wise z then mean imputer/standard scaler; global fits TRAIN only
objective: one channel-mean BCE update per patient; pos_weight=binary_FIT_EZ/binary_FIT_NEZ
initialization: explicit seed=42+1009*fold before model init; same saved initial state for all students; reseed to same seed before training
initialization_caveat: historical wrapper constructed model before train reseed and did not save initial weights; exact frozen inference replay is verified, new matched A0 not bitwise historical training replay
A2_targets: y+lambda*u*(q-y); q/u detached frozen patient-OOF teacher
teacher_internal_validation: ceil(.2*remaining_patients) from default_rng(teacher_seed).permutation(sorted_remaining_IDs); excludes query and outer VAL/TEST
teacher_training: same B0 model, optimizer, loss, early stop and selection; preprocess teacher TRAIN only
MC_seed: teacher_seed+9000000; only Dropout train, all other modules eval, no_grad
uncertainty: normalized Bernoulli entropy(mean NEZ probability), clamp q to [1e-6,1-1e-6]
bootstrap_unit: patient ID; resampled ID retains every repeated validation appearance; mean over retained patient-fold cells

development_gate.ez_f1_materiality_interpretation: conservative nondecline frozen before training; no post-outcome tolerance

diagnostics.magnitude_control: no extra training; stratify A2/A1 decision changes by max-lambda A2 target movement relative to .05 fixed smoothing and describe mismatch of average correction
diagnostics.uncertainty_interpretation: predictive ambiguity, not clinical label-error probability

test_rule: no new outer inference unless development gate passes; then one hash-locked exploratory repeated-test evaluation of all original channels
gate_replay_exception: historical B0-only frozen outer replay required before A2; not model selection
runtime: existing isolated NumPy1.26.4 / Torch2.8.0+cu128; base environment unchanged
public_outputs: source and compact aggregate artifacts only
